title: Executor binding library (plan §5, §9 W1)
description: Per-combo parameterizations of hand-written executor archetypes, keyed by Spellbook combo id (global — bindings are per-combo, not per-deck). Hand-authored today; Gate 3.5 bindgen emits the same format, gated by the sandbox sim-verifier (a binding that fails validate() never becomes executable). Unknown archetypes leave a combo detection-only with the generic fallback — data can never crash a batch.

params.description: Archetype-specific parameters. TapForManaUntapLoop: engine, untapper, activation_cost, untap_cost, untap_ability_host (engine|untapper — Mantle GRANTS its ability to the engine), self_pump_per_cycle, yield_expr, profit_invariant.

payoffs.description: Cards the line's win conversion leans on — LethalityPlanner input, informational here.

entry_phase.description: Default MAIN1 — combat must remain available for DEPLOY_WIN endings (v3.1).

unbound.description: Combo ids deliberately left detection-only, so 'no binding' is a recorded decision, not an omission.
